t: Floor cleaner cuts through tough grease and grime to leave a sparkling finish. Ideal for use on all hard floors including vinyl, tiles, painted floors and laminates, as well as tiled walls and work surfaces. Suitable for use with a mop and bucket, all scrubber drier machines, or in a trigger spray for spot cleaning. Fresh natural lemon fragrance.
b: Use With Bucket & Mop or in Floor Cleaning Machines
